title: Registration / fitness expired
description: Review the official RC/registration validity date and any expired fitness/registration status.

title: RC renewal not processed
description: Identify any renewal application paid online but still pending/not inwarded at the RTO.

title: Vehicle status non-compliant
description: Investigate any NTR/VAHAN blacklist or non-compliant status and its cause.

title: Accident-history record
description: If a portal shows an accident count, obtain the actual event date, source and repair details.

title: Motor-vehicle tax validity
description: Compare current tax-validity field with payment transaction history and arrears.

title: Pollution certificate expired
description: Check current official PUC expiry and obtain certificate or reason not available.

title: HSRP record
description: Check official HSRP record and physical plates where required.

title: Previous owner / finance history
description: Check previous owner count, financier and any transfer/loan history.

title: Odometer history
description: Compare dashboard kilometres with historic service and inspection readings.

title: Steering-wheel emblem
description: Check any steering wheel/branded component mismatch, SRS airbag and horn.

title: Original RC or official electronic RC
description: Match registration, vehicle model/variant variant, fuel, full VIN, engine no. and registered owner.

title: Current approved RC expiry
description: Obtain current approved renewal/validity, not just the fee receipt.

title: Owner identity and authority
description: Verify identity of the registered owner or a written authority to sell.

title: Ownership count / transfers
description: Obtain official previous-owner count and transfer history; presently unknown.

title: Physical VIN stamping
description: Compare the full 17-character metal marking with the RC and receipt.

title: Physical engine-number marking
description: Find and compare the complete engine number with registered details.

title: Active bank hypothecation
description: Verify whether a financier or loan is recorded on the registration.

title: Loan closure, if applicable
description: Request lender NOC, Form 35 and removal of hypothecation from RC.

title: Vehicle blacklist or hold
description: Check any police/RTO hold, blacklist or restriction on vehicle services.

title: National and state challans
description: Record national no-match result; Maharashtra owner-OTP check remains incomplete.

title: Insurance policy and identity
description: Match current insurance policy, expiry and registration; review coverage terms.

title: PUC, HSRP and tax records
description: Check current PUC, plate fitment, MV tax dues and supporting receipts.

title: Manufacturing month/year
description: Check build date plate or OEM invoice; registration date can differ from date of manufacture.

title: Exact variant and safety equipment
description: Compare registered trim, fitted features, engine, airbags and ABS to OEM brochure and VIN-specific build records.

title: Loan or other liens across owner changes
description: If hypothecation was ever present, check official removal and documented financier clearance.

title: Commercial/taxi use and vehicle class
description: Verify current and previous registered class where documented; private-use claim must align with documents.

title: Previous dated odometer readings
description: Compare the displayed odometer with historical service bills, inspection records and invoices.

title: Manufacturer-authorised workshop history
description: Request dated service and body-repair records from a workshop independently chosen by the buyer.

title: Insurance claim history
description: Request owner-authorised claim, loss assessment and cashless repairs data.

title: NTR accident-history detail
description: Obtain particulars for any accident history count, including date and damage.

title: Front chassis rails / apron
description: Inspect crash members, radiator support, joints and repair welds.

title: Rear crash structure / boot floor
description: Remove spare-wheel cover; inspect seams, distortion and replacement panels.

title: Roof, A/B/C pillars
description: Inspect structural areas for weld repairs, filler and alignment.

title: Door, bonnet and boot alignment
description: Compare panel gaps, bolts, sealant and opening/closing operation.

title: Paint-thickness and matching
description: Look for repaint and filler differences; repaint alone is not proof of a crash.

title: Flood and water ingress
description: Inspect seat rails, footwells, under-carpets, connectors and corrosion.

title: VIN plate / stamping integrity
description: Check tampering, substituted tags, grinding and unusual re-stamping.

title: Steering assembly / SRS
description: Identify non-original wheel/emblem if observed; verify airbag system and horn.

title: Previous listing and auction photos
description: Search exact VIN/plate for older sales, salvage, dealer photos and repeated kilometre claims.

title: Airbag deployment and SRS parts
description: Check airbag presence and original fitment, mounting points, trim, seat pretensioners and SRS DTCs.

title: Tyre age vs odometer claim
description: Compare tyre DOT age and wear to claimed usage; normal replacements are not evidence of tampering.

title: Form 25 renewal application
description: Ask for completed/acknowledged renewal application and required attachments.

title: Application inward / acceptance
description: Verify the recorded renewal application was formally received and processed by MH-01.

title: Vehicle inspection appointment
description: Obtain the inspection booking, test date and inspecting authority.

title: Fitness / roadworthiness inspection
description: Request an actual dated inspection result; fee payment alone is not an inspection.

title: Accepted fitness test result
description: Obtain recorded pass/fail outcome and any defect or reinspection notice.

title: Approved renewed RC
description: Verify approval, new validity date and vehicle registration status in VAHAN.

title: RC printing or electronic issue
description: Obtain updated RC; check application print/dispatch status.

title: Current tax/arrears clearance
description: Reconcile the latest MV Tax payment with the registration validity field.

title: Current valid PUC
description: Obtain a new certificate and confirm online expiry and vehicle identity.

title: Insurance certificate
description: Present valid insurance matching registration and owner as needed.

title: Chassis/engine pencil print
description: Prepare if required by local RTO, matching the physical vehicle markings.

title: HSRP fitment or compliance
description: Check physical plate installation and any necessary fitment/order status.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: Low/high beam and headlight aim
description: Test both sides, dip/high switching and beam aim; replace damaged lenses.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: Brake, tail and indicator lamps
description: Verify brake lights, both turn signals, hazards and tail lamps.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: Reverse, parking and number-plate lights
description: Check reverse lamps, parking lamps and plate illumination.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: Reflectors and exterior visibility
description: Check lenses, reflectors and conspicuity without broken or missing parts.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: Windscreen and safety glass
description: Check cracks, major chips, tinted alterations and glass installation.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: Wipers and washer jets
description: Check front wipe pattern, blades, washer spray and motor speeds.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: Rear-view and side mirrors
description: Verify both mirrors are secure, undamaged and adjustable.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: Horn
description: Confirm reliable operation and appropriate sound.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: Speedometer and dashboard gauges
description: Verify speedometer, odometer, temperature gauge and warning lights.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: Front and rear seat belts
description: Verify all fitted belts latch, retract and show no fraying or alteration.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: Seat mountings and head restraints
description: Check front/rear seat anchors, rails and restraints where fitted.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: Doors, bonnet and boot latches
description: Ensure secure latching; check child locks and central locking.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: Registration plates
description: Check secure readable plate and correct registration; inspect HSRP fitment.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: Tyres including spare
description: Check size, damage, tread depth, tyre age and available spare/tools.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: High-mounted brake light
description: Verify centre high-mounted stop lamp where factory-equipped and its wiring.

section: FITNESS - LIGHTS, GLASS AND PASSENGER SAFETY
title: Child safety seats and ISOFIX
description: Inspect available child-seat anchors and seat belt usability if transporting children.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Service brake performance
description: Verify even effective braking; request brake-tester reading if available.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Parking / handbrake efficiency
description: Confirm secure holding and inspection of rear-brake operation.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Brake lines, fluid and hoses
description: Inspect leakage, corrosion, worn flexible hoses and fluid condition.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Steering free play and joints
description: Check tie rods, steering rack, play, play-related knocks and mounts.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Suspension and shock absorbers
description: Inspect springs, bushes, struts, dampers and wheel alignment.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Wheel hubs, bearings and fasteners
description: Check abnormal play, bearing noise, wheel studs and lug nuts.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Chassis / subframe integrity
description: Inspect frame, subframes, cross-members, corrosion and repairs on lift.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Exhaust, silencer and mounting
description: Check leakage, excess noise, loose hangers and exhaust position.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Petrol emissions and PUC test
description: Measure regulated exhaust pollutants and obtain valid current PUC.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Fuel system and tank
description: Inspect fuel lines, clamps, tank, filler neck and leakage.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Engine / transmission fluid leaks
description: Check engine, gearbox, steering and coolant leaks from underneath.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Speedometer/side-slip/headlamp tests
description: Request instrument test outputs if performed at test station.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Battery/alternator charging
description: Check starting and charging voltage, terminals and earth connections.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Airbag and ABS self-check
description: Confirm warning lamps self-test normally; use OBD where supported.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Tyre sidewall damage and pressures
description: Check bulges, cracks, puncture repair, matching tyres and correct cold pressures.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: Headlamp tester or alignment
description: Request beam aim test if available and inspect mounts for damage.

section: FITNESS - BRAKES, STEERING, EMISSIONS AND CHASSIS
title: ABS and brake warning diagnostics
description: Confirm normal bulb check and no persistent ABS/brake fault on engine-running test.

title: Cold engine start
description: Start cold; inspect starting effort, smoke, rattling and unusual vibration.

title: Idling and acceleration
description: Check idling stability, engine sounds and smooth acceleration.

title: Cooling system under load
description: Warm the engine, test fan operation and monitor overheating or coolant loss.

title: Oil / coolant contamination
description: Check fluid levels, sludge, coolant/oil mixing and visible leakage.

title: Clutch operation
description: Check bite point, judder, slip and pedal effort under safe load.

title: First and second gear driving
description: Test low-speed gear changes, hesitation and transmission noises.

title: Higher gears and reverse
description: Check engagement, synchronisers, road speed and reverse.

title: Steering behaviour
description: Check drift, vibration, tracking and return to centre.

title: Suspension on uneven road
description: Listen for knocks and assess ride stability at safe speed.

title: Braking during road test
description: Check stopping stability, pedal travel and unusual noises.

title: AC and ventilation
description: Check AC at idle and driving speeds; blower and vents.

title: Electrical accessories
description: Test power windows, locks, horn, wipers and all relevant switches.

title: OBD diagnostic scan
description: Record engine/ABS/SRS fault codes; no code does not prove no past damage.

title: Complete supervised road test
description: Conduct safe test with inspector where legally permitted and insured.

title: Drive belts and timing system
description: Inspect applicable timing chain/belt service, accessory belts and tensioners; use OEM schedule.

title: Engine mounts and drivetrain joints
description: Inspect vibrations, mount cracks, axle/CV boots, differential noises.

title: A/C coolant fan and idle loading
description: Run AC at idle in traffic-like conditions; observe temperature and compressor behaviour.

title: Diesel injector, turbo and emissions components
description: Check smoke, boost leaks, EGR/DPF (where fitted), injector faults and previous repairs.

title: CNG approval / RTO endorsement
description: Verify factory/aftermarket kit documentation and RC fuel endorsement; no unrecorded conversion.

title: CNG cylinder, plumbing and leaks
description: Check cylinder approval/hydrotest date where required, regulator, tank mounts and gas leakage.

title: EV high-voltage battery state of health
description: Request manufacturer diagnostic SoH and battery health history from qualified EV technician.

title: EV charging, BMS and cooling
description: Inspect charge port, AC/DC charging, HV isolation faults and cooling loops.

title: Hybrid battery and regenerative braking
description: Check hybrid battery diagnostics, inverter cooling and regen/physical brake function.

title: Lift and underbody photographs
description: Obtain images of mounts, crash members, corrosion and leakage.

title: Independent written inspection
description: Obtain dated workshop report with engine, body and safety findings.

title: Written repair cost estimate
description: Separate required mechanical/safety work from optional cosmetics.

title: Seller authority / owner identity
description: Ensure seller has documents and authority for the sale.

title: Loan and legal dues
description: Confirm responsibility for financier closure, taxes and pending challans.

title: Vehicle sale agreement
description: Include registration, VIN, engine number, terms, date and known defects.

title: Advance/deposit conditions
description: Document any advance amount and refund terms in writing.

title: Ownership transfer paperwork
description: Obtain correct transfer forms and submission acknowledgement.

title: Completion of buyer name transfer
description: Obtain VAHAN update/RC in buyer name, when completed.

title: Insurance transfer or new policy
description: Confirm buyer insurance is effective as required.

title: Service records and keys
description: Receive service bills, spare keys and supplied accessories.

title: Comparable listing evidence
description: Record sources, variant, model year, mileage and asking price.

title: Inspect VIN on physical stamped metal
description: Photograph physical location and compare each character to RC; do not rely only on windscreen sticker.

title: Mechanical test results and measurement evidence
description: Preserve OBD codes, compression/leak down where necessary, brake tester and tyre measurements.

title: Seller declarations of modifications
description: List aftermarket LPG/CNG, wheel, airbags, ECU, lights, suspension, crash repairs.

title: Receipt after transfer completion
description: Capture VAHAN transfer approval and updated buyer details; an application alone is not completion.

title: Insurer policy transfer / new coverage
description: Confirm effective date, coverage and named insured as applicable before road use.

title: Latest approved RC expiry and status documented
description: Record the result and supporting evidence before closing this item.

title: pending renewal application disposition documented
description: Record the result and supporting evidence before closing this item.

title: RTO fitness inspection/test result obtained
description: Record the result and supporting evidence before closing this item.

title: Any accident history indicator investigated
description: Record the result and supporting evidence before closing this item.

title: Physical VIN and engine number matched to RC
description: Record the result and supporting evidence before closing this item.

title: Ownership count and hypothecation verified
description: Record the result and supporting evidence before closing this item.

title: Roadworthiness / safety inspection report obtained
description: Record the result and supporting evidence before closing this item.

title: PUC, tax, insurance and plate status checked
description: Record the result and supporting evidence before closing this item.
